extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and practitioners (patent attorneys/agents) interacting with USPTO examiners
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on requesting, scheduling, conducting, and documenting interviews with USPTO patent examiners, including use of the Automated Interview Request (AIR) tool, required forms/authorizations, video-conference hosting rules, and best practices for preparation and recordation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of USPTO AIR / Automated Interview Request
rubrics_metrics.description: USPTO AIR is a web-based tool that allows Applicants to request an interview with an Examiner for their pending patent application. Applicants may file their Automated Interview Request (AIR) via Patent Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Automated Interview Request form will be located in Patent Center (found under the Existing Submissions dropdown). After the form is submitted, an examiner will respond to you to confirm your request within two business days. (Note: announcement: effective March 9, 2026 the AIR form will be located in Patent Center.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit Applicant Initiated Interview Request (PTOL-413A) before interview
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant initiating an interview request should submit an 'Applicant Initiated Interview Request' form (PTOL-413A) prior to the interview in order for the examiner to prepare for the interview and to focus on the issues to be discussed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitting PTOL-413A helps the examiner prepare and focus the discussion. See MPEP Chapter 713.01, section IV (Scheduling and Conducting an Interview) for additional information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorization to communicate via the internet (PTO/SB/439)
rubrics_metrics.description: PTO/SB/439 – A document to provide authorization to communicate via the internet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PTO/SB/439 where required to authorize internet communications between applicant/practitioner and the examiner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video conference hosting requirement (US PTO hosts Teams meetings)
rubrics_metrics.description: All interviews held via video conference must be originated or 'hosted' by the USPTO. The Microsoft Teams invitation must be sent by the examiner and not the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Microsoft Teams is used for video conference interviews. The examiner should send the Teams invitation; applicants should not initiate the Teams meeting. If you have issues, contact ExaminerInterviewPractice@uspto.gov or your TC Interview Specialist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video conference recordings and interview summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Video conference interviews will not be recorded. The substance of the interview will be documented by the examiner in an interview summary according to standard practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not expect an official recording; ensure that the interview's substance is captured via the examiner's interview summary. Consider confirming key points on the record during the interview and following up in writing if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview Specialists role and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Interview Specialists are subject matter experts in each Technology Center (TC) and regional office who specialize in information pertaining to interview practice and policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interview Specialists are available to assist with interviews, including facilitating and assisting with technical issues (e.g., TEAMS problems, public interview room setup). Contact the TC Interview Specialist based on the Technology Center where the application is docketed for questions or comments about interview practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow MPEP interview and internet-communication guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevant Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) sections apply to interviews and internet communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP Chapter 500-502.03 (Communication via Internet), MPEP Chapter 700-713 (Interviews), and MPEP Chapter 713.01, section IV (Scheduling and Conducting an Interview) for policies and procedures governing interview practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use an agenda and prepare for the interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective Interview Practice discusses the use of an agenda and preparing for the interview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an agenda to focus the discussion and allow the examiner to prepare for the issues to be discussed. Preparation improves the efficiency and substance of the interview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper recordation and clarifying the record
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective Interview Practice emphasizes properly recording the interview to clarify the record and Interview Best Practices identifies recordation as a useful tool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although video conferences are not recorded, take steps during the interview to clarify and document key points; rely on the examiner's interview summary and consider follow-up written communications to ensure the record accurately reflects the discussion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key best-practice dimensions: accessibility, preparation, substance, recordation
rubrics_metrics.description: Interview Best Practices identifies accessibility, preparation, substance, and recordation as useful tools and techniques for effective interview practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When planning and conducting interviews, attend to accessibility (ensuring participants can access the platform/room), thorough preparation (materials and agenda), substantive focus (clearly state issues and proposed resolutions), and appropriate recordation (ensuring the interview summary captures the substance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Register update permitting oral authorization for video conferencing
rubrics_metrics.description: USPTO is updating its Internet usage policy by modifying the authorization requirements to now permit oral authorization for video conferencing tools, such as TEAMS, to be provided by the patent applicant/practitioner to patent examiners before an interview is conducted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Federal Register notice for details on the policy change and how oral authorization may be given prior to interviews using video conferencing tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Interview Room and related FAQs/training resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources (Public Interview Room PDF, Effective Interview Practice, Interview Best Practices, Interview Practice Training Summary, FAQs) provide additional policies, procedures, tools, and training to enable better communication with examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the listed PDFs and training materials for detailed procedural guidance, frequently asked questions, and practical tips for setting up and conducting effective interviews (including public interview room logistics).
